confirmed_reference_defect.before: QuTiP Gaussian-seeded oscillator kernel underflowed for high-order appreciable wavefunctions at |x|>38.
confirmed_reference_defect.fix: Separate scaled generalized-Laguerre oscillator evaluator; no local-Hermite fallback. Direct scalar gold uses mpmath90dps, including n16383/x160 and n16382/x120. QuTiP still supplies circuit operators and small direct ODE controls.

memory_implementation: Streaming q/p conditional grids, no Ndata*Ny state bank; light real tridiagonal data basis, independent exact product spectral SUM, tiled real/imag transforms; uniform path row-tiles sealed transfer files and maps one data-cutoff block at a time.
